Stellar Crown

Released September 13, 2024 · 175 cards

StandardExpanded

Stellar Crown is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Scarlet & Violet series, released in English on September 13, 2024. Its main set has 142 cards, plus 33 secret rares numbered beyond the set (175 in total). It includes 153 Pokémon, 22 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.
